item.title: Chartrand wanted by Sault police
item.description: Joseph Andre Chartrand is wanted by police. Chartrand, 67, is sought on five charges including having a blood/alcohol level of more than 80 milligrams and drive while under suspension, a release says. Anyone with information about Chartrand can call Sault Ste. Marie Police Service at 705-949-6300 or Crime Stoppers at 705-942-7867 or saultcrimestoppers.com.

item.title: Thessalon emergency department shutters Thursday morning
Sault man pleads to child porn possession
item.description: A man pleaded guilty to possessing and distributing child pornography. Tyler Kehoe made the pleas, dating from offences dated Oct. 5, 2024 and Feb. 17, 2025, before Ontario Court Justice John Condon on Wednesday. Defence counsel Eric McCooeye requested pre-sentence and Gladue reports for his client, who is Indigenous. Kehoe returns to court Feb. 9.
